fields.intervention: design IOL surface with anti-adhesive microstructure or hydrophilic coating to prevent capsule adhesion and fluid trapping

fields.falsification_test: compare fluid volume and bacterial load in capsular bag of patients with standard vs modified IOL over 1 month post‑op
fields.mechanism_source_span: "We hypothesize that mechanical athalamia due to eye rubbing was an acute trigger leading to forward IOL displacement, adhering it to the anterior capsule and trapping fluid."
